items.$comment: South Africa has three capitals: Pretoria (executive), Cape Town (legislative), Bloemfontein (judicial). This is NOT a single-answer question — it is flagged for review so a human decides how to present it. Cape Town and Bloemfontein must never be usable as distractors here, because they are also correct. See the sensitive-content policy.
